lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Your sensor mast is broadcasting three kinds of noise and one of them is probably intentional.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: You got all that from looking at the ship?

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: From listening. Ten crates and a berth, and I will make the instruments tell you useful lies instead.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Excellent. I have instruments, notebooks, and exactly one bag of snacks. We can leave.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: A shame. I was curious how long the mast would survive.

options.line: Ten crates and a berth. Welcome aboard.
